checks: strict separate projection rejects widened budgets, nonfinite/overlong windows and inconsistent remaining/active state
finite window uses observed server time plus elapsed duration and expires independently of cleanup
fixed-identity meter maps only its own reservations and late/uncertain settlements, preserving one stable request ID
actual runtime verifies private original bytes before canary reserve and uses new metering only for the fixed document
forged/wrong originals and invoice-less or opt-in requests cannot dispatch or reserve canary inference
disabled/expired/mismatched funding fails before dispatch; fresh funding prevents a second paid action after reserve
an exactly exhausted allowance still permits its already-reserved dispatch within the valid window
a paid response crossing expiry still settles measured charge and cannot persist a new proposal
ordinary conversations from both employees and chris_dev retain general-budget denial and Qwen fallback, never the allowance
scope: Actual runtime/client/meter code with synthetic Auth/RPC/provider transport and approved PDF bytes; not JWT/RLS/database or live model evidence
